description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across different categories, including Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis lists these categories in a fixed order, while the vertical axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, marked at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing two bars: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a dark blue bar representing TA-SQL. The bars for NatSQL have approximate values of 60.21, 40.86, 32.32, and 51.35 for Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, respectively, while the corresponding bars for TA-SQL have values of 63.14, 48.60, 36.11, and 56.19. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across the different categories.
